message.reasoning:
Mark each criterion. C1: intro covers mission, rationale, single spacecraft, users partially (operator implied, customers vague). Adequate-to-accomplished; give 7? Users not clearly identified (operator/customers). Some referencing. I'd say 6 (Adequate high). C2: launch, orbit with elements, maneuvers, ground control, comms frequency, duration/EOL — all addressed with STK screenshots. Some errors: Kourou latitude stated 45.05°N (actually ~5.2°N) — clear error. Also "very high altitude would yield low resolution images which is also desirable" — contradictory wording. Inclination 87.79° at 600km — check: SSO inclination at 600 km is ~97.8°, not 87.79°. The plot shows ~97.8 at 600. Student wrote 87.7924° — error (retrograde means >90). Table says 87.79°. Major technical error. Also RAAN 27.33° "indicates location of launch facility" — dubious. So C2 Adequate, 5-6. Give 5. C3: conclusion decent, specific. 7. C4: structure ok, figures labelled somewhat, references are bare URLs, Wikipedia used (not acceptable source). Adequate, 5.

Requirements: R1 yes, R2 yes, R3 partial, R4 yes, R5 partial (inclination error), R6 yes, R7 yes, R8 yes, R9 yes, R10 partial (screenshots yes; files not shown), R11 partial (Wikipedia, bare URLs).
